name: 40383 · Versailles, KY
findings: ZIP 40383 (Versailles) has 109 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 40383 (Versailles) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
